description: Byte budgets for scripts/check_perf_budget.py. To raise one, add a history entry (new max_bytes + reason) at the end and set max_bytes to the same number; see docs/operations/perf-budget.md.

history.reason: Initial budget (SC-PERF-BUDGET-1). Measured 421,933 bytes on main 771d317133 (stated figure: landing page entry plus the scripts it imports at once) plus 5.5% headroom. PERF-BASELINE-1 A.4: landing cold 527 KB on the wire, 53 script requests, which also includes the map engine loaded on demand.

Raised 445,000 to 460,000 (3.2% over the 445,953 measured on main 6aad80f4ca). The shared English and Spanish string catalogue (SC0707-05 landing translation, SC0452-08 language choice) grew assets/strings.js, which the landing page loads at once, so main already measured 445,953 and failed this check before the plan-view change in this pull request (which does not touch the landing page). The catalogue is the product's Spanish support; the budget keeps a small headroom so further growth is still flagged.

Lowered 460,000 to 304,000 (SC1407-09, #1762 M5). The Spanish table now loads only for a Spanish page, so the landing's first load carries English only. Vite manifest static closure of landing.html: 447,318 bytes on main a5005eb05, 289,476 with this change; ceiling = ceil(289,476 x 1.05 / 1,000) x 1,000.
Initial budget (SC-PERF-BUDGET-1). Measured 24,339 bytes plus 6.8% headroom. PERF-BASELINE-1 A.4: landing css 18 KB on the wire.

Raised 26,000 to 29,000 (SC1922-05). The landing's phone layout now reserves the height each late-mounting part takes (readout, port form, actions row, footer, layer dots) in web/landing/landing.css and web/landing/port-input.css, which removes the phone's three layout shifts (cold CLS 0.213 at 390 px and 0.249 at 360 px on main, 0.000 after). The reservations are about 2 KB of new rules; the landing first-load styles measure 27,808 bytes on this build (assets landing css 9.2 KB, degraded-notice 15.0 KB, tokens 3.0 KB), so the budget moves up 3,000 bytes (4.3% headroom over that build), no more.
Initial budget (SC-PERF-BUDGET-1). Measured 1,104,511 bytes plus 5.0% headroom. PERF-BASELINE-1 A.4: brief cold 767 KB of script on the wire, 63 script requests.

Raised 1,160,000 to 1,170,000 (0.9% over the 1,160,081 measured on this branch merged with main 109ae09f). Main alone already measures 1,132.7 KB against the 1,132.8 KB budget (earlier fixes used up the headroom); RF0804-7 adds a small amount of minified code in PositionCheck.tsx that tags each retained position-check result with its region and dialog life, which puts the first load 81 bytes over. The new code removes a wrong-region result and a stale answer after the dialog closes, which is worth the bytes.

Raised 1,170,000 to 1,180,000 (0.9% over the 1,170,408 measured on this branch merged with main 2c5eae23, 408 bytes over). SC1407-06 adds the shared live-boundary reader (dist/live-mpa.js, imported by web/map/marks.ts and dist/protected-areas.js) so the map's mark screen and the planner's screen make one request for the same in-flight ds582 query instead of two; the extra minified code in the app entry is worth the saved request and parse.

Lowered 1,180,000 to 1,064,000 (SC1407-09, #1762 M5). The Spanish table now loads only for a Spanish page, so the app's first load carries English only. Vite manifest static closure of app.html: 1,169,280 bytes on main a5005eb05, 1,011,409 with this change on that base, 1,012,688 after merging main 07621807 (SC1407-06 and others); ceiling = ceil(1,012,688 x 1.05 / 1,000) x 1,000.

Lowered 1,064,000 to 1,059,000 (SC1407-10, #1762 M5). The trip planner, offline pack, basemap ranges and coastal snapshots moved from web/trip.ts to web/trip-runtime.ts, loaded on first use, so the app's first load no longer carries them. Vite manifest static closure of app.html: 1,007,939 bytes on this branch merged with main 1deba4ec (SC1407-09 and the earlier entries included); ceiling = ceil(1,007,939 x 1.05 / 1,000) x 1,000.

The budget moves up 1,000 bytes (1.3% headroom over that build), no more.
